social.og_description: Issues, tasks per team, moderation on public QR portals, calendar and briefing — no app.

facility.title: Facility management via QR portals
facility.lead: WinProx Facility links every unit to a digital portal: report, approve, assign tasks and complete work in one flow.

problem.title: What problem does it solve?
problem.body: Defects and requests scatter across phone, Excel and email. Field teams lack context; managers lack overview. WinProx centralises issue → tasks → completion.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Scan the unit QR to report (with photos). Staff approve (public stays blurred until then). Tasks go to operational teams. Workers act via Clock Point + unit QR on site.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
items: Locations and units with QR (individual or sticker sheet)
Public report portals with moderation/blur until approval
Multiple tasks per issue, each assigned to one team
Teams, workers and teamleader flows on the floor

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: Facility coordinators, maintenance teams and organisations with multiple buildings or assets that need tight control of issues and tasks.

time.meta_title: Time tracking via Clock Point QR | WinProx

social.og_title: Time tracking via Clock Point QR | WinProx
social.og_description: Clock in/out and breaks via Clock Point QR, presence and shifts — linked to facility workflows.

time.logo_alt: Module Time — part of WinProx Facility
time.title: Time tracking via Clock Point
time.lead: WinProx Time lets workers clock in with the same QR approach as facility: fast on the floor, visible to managers.

problem.title: What problem does it solve?
problem.body: Presence and shifts often live in a separate tool, disconnected from issues and tasks — making it hard to see who was on site when.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Clock Point QR for sign-in and clock in/out. Managers see presence, alarms and shift overviews in Time.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
items: Clock in and out via Clock Point
Same worker identity (name + icon) as facility

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: Organisations that want presence tied to field work and facility follow-up, without a separate time-clock app.

social.og_description: Optional ESG module: indicators, measurements and follow-up tasks linked to units and QR portals.

esg.title: ESG measurements in the same portal
esg.lead: The ESG module adds indicators and measurements to WinProx so sustainability and compliance data live next to facility tasks.

problem.title: What problem does it solve?
problem.body: ESG data often sits in spreadsheets, away from the floor. Thresholds and follow-up get lost between teams.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Define indicators, record measurements (including field flows where relevant) and attach follow-up tasks when thresholds need action — in the same tenant as Facility.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: Organisations that want facility and ESG closer together without a separate silo system.

qr.meta_title: QR portals for reporting & field work | WinProx

social.og_title: QR portals for reporting & field work | WinProx
social.og_description: Unit QR, Clock Point QR and location QR: reporting and field work in the browser, no app install.

qr.title: How QR portals work
qr.lead: WinProx centres on physical QR codes that open a digital portal: for reporters, field workers and (optionally) clocking.

problem.title: What problem does it solve?
problem.body: Without local context, reports stay generic (“somewhere leaking”). Installing apps on shared devices fails. QR brings the right unit and workflow forward.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Unit QR for reporting and tasks on that unit. Clock Point QR for worker login (and Time). Location QR for a general location link. All in the browser.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
items: Unit QR: report + worker tasks on site
Clock Point QR: sign-in / clock in
Location QR and sticker sheets (e.g. Avery)
Dynamic QR that can be assigned to a unit later
Moderation: blur until approval on public pages

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: Any organisation that wants reporting and field work to start from the physical place — without an app store or separate field app.

social.og_description: Connect sensor gateways: alarms become issues; on Corporate also ESG measurements.

iot.title: Sensors that start work
iot.lead: WinProx stays the workflow engine: gateways send events, you set the rules. No hardware lock-in.

problem.title: What problem does it solve?
problem.body: Sensor alarms live in separate dashboards while facility teams work in WinProx. Follow-up gets fragmented.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Alarm → approved issue → task for the right team. On Corporate: measurements into ESG alongside the same issue flow.

capabilities.title: Features
items: Event log without a time-series dump

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: Facility organisations that want leak detection, doors, temperature or meters tied into existing issues and tasks.
